subject: Tech Accelerator - Cyber Valley x ARENA2036 Webinar 24 November
text:
OFFICIAL

Hi all,

Cyber Valley has confirmed the details for the upcoming webinar co-hosted with ARENA2036 on
24 November from 10:00-12:30 CET – I will share a calendar blocker shortly. Please find the session outline attached.

Cyber Valley is Europe’s largest AI research consortium, uniting top universities and companies like Bosch, Amazon, and Mercedes-Benz to drive innovation in AI and robotics.

ARENA2036 is a Stuttgart-based research campus focused on future mobility and production, with partners like Daimler and Schaeffler collaborating in open labs to accelerate industrial
 transformation.

The aim of the session is to facilitate an exchange similar to our workshop with IPAI and BioPro—learning how to best engage with their networks. You’ll also have the opportunity to engage with Cyber Valley’s Senior Advisor
 during the Q&A. We highly recommend asking specific questions around partnership opportunities and corporate engagement.

We’ll be in touch soon with further details.

Best wishes,

Johanna & Jane
